text:
olivia: Heads-up — weekly release train is starting. Release tag release-2024.02.5. Main points: canary rolling now, release freeze starts Fri 18:00 PT -> Mon 06:00 PT, exceptions via #release-requests. Full plan: https://go.redwood/release-2024-02-5 :rocket:
release-bot: Deploy started: service=api-gateway, env=canary, tag=release-2024.02.5, canary=5% :white_check_mark:
kevin: Does this affect Dedicated customers on reserved pools?
olivia: Not for the infra-level changes. There is one client header change that will require a minor agent update for on-prem. We'll call that out below.
maria: Which header? Need to prep release notes for Private customers.
olivia: It's `X-RW-Infer-Mode` -> `X-RW-Inference-Mode`. We added backwards-compat code, but please plan to push agent 2.8.1 for Private next week. Migration doc: https://go.redwood/migrate-agent-2-8
sara: If a team needs an exception to the freeze window, what's the flow?
olivia: Ping #release-requests with payload: service, reason, rollback-plan, approvers. Product/SRE signoff required for emergency merges. Expect 24–48h review.
oncall-pager: Monitoring note: small latency spike seen in eu-west-1 at 15:02 UTC. Investigating.
kevin: Saw that — it's the canary traffic shape, latency back to baseline for most pods. Watching CPU on g4x nodes.
devops: Quick health check for anyone: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.dev/status | jq .` — returns {"ok":true,"version":"release-2024.02.5-canary"} on canary hosts.
release-bot: Canary progress: api-gateway 5% -> 25% (2024-02-27T16:30Z). No errors flagged.
maria: Noted. I'll add the header warning to the Private ops email and include the agent upgrade checklist.
kevin: Ops team — if CPU stays high beyond 30m we should throttle canary and roll back.
olivia: Agreed. We'll pause at 25% if we see any >3% error increase for 10m.
release-bot: Canary progress: api-gateway 25% -> 50% (2024-02-27T17:05Z). No error rate increase.
oncall-pager: Alert cleared. Latency normalized.
sara: Any post-rollout validation steps for feature flags?
olivia: Owners — run the smoke suite (link: https://go.redwood/smoke) and confirm in this thread. Leave thumbs-up when you finish.
maria: Confirmed smoke run passed for Private staging.
kevin: Confirmed for Dedicated staging.
olivia: Final note: release freeze reminder — no non-critical merges after Fri 18:00 PT. If you need to land something urgent, follow exception flow. Thanks team — will post final 'train completed' message once rollout hits 100%. :tada:
